versions.title: Updater Signature Recovery & Release Integrity
versions.summary: Fixed automatic update failures caused by incomplete release-signature metadata and added secure recovery from the canonical LogiSource release server.
changes: Fixed automatic update failures caused by truncated or incomplete RSA-3072 signature metadata from CRM/API.
Updater now validates decoded signature length against the installed RSA public key.
When CRM/API signature metadata is invalid, incomplete, or fails verification, updater retries with signature-base64.txt from the same approved release directory as the package.
Canonical signature fallback is restricted to HTTPS on release.logisourcedigital.web.id.
Canonical fallback is still cryptographically verified with the installed RSA public key; no signature verification bypass was introduced.
SHA256 package verification remains mandatory before digital-signature verification.
Improved updater diagnostics for invalid or incomplete release signatures.
No database migration is required.
Application restart is required after update.

versions.title: Compact Category QR Manager & Direct PDF Links
versions.summary: Refined the Inventory category QR interface for large category lists and changed category QR/Public Links to deliver the category PDF directly.
changes: Inventory QR/Public Link by Category is collapsed by default behind one View QR Public Link Category action.
The category list appears only after the section is opened.
Category details and QR/link actions appear only after a category is selected.
The category list uses a bounded scroll area so large installations do not expand the Inventory page excessively.
Added category search for installations with many Inventory categories.
Only one category detail panel can be open at a time.
Category QR codes now point directly to the branded Inventory PDF for that category.
Open Public Link now opens/downloads the selected category PDF directly instead of opening the public HTML page.
Copy Link now copies the direct public category PDF link.
Existing signed-token, reset, disable/enable, and rate-limit protections remain in place.
No database migration is required.

versions.title: Category Cabinet QR & Granular Inventory Permissions
versions.summary: Added one secure public Inventory QR per category/cabinet and granular per-user Inventory permissions for View, Add, Edit/Adjust, Delete, and Public QR management.
changes: Each Inventory category now has its own stable QR/Public Link for a physical cabinet.
A new Inventory category automatically receives a new category QR link.
Inventory QR management shows one View QR / Public Link action per category instead of one all-inventory QR.
Each category public page is permanently scoped to that category and cannot switch to another category.
Category public pages support search, Type, Stock Status, Storage Location, and sorting.
Public category Excel/PDF exports keep the selected category scope and use the full Inventory report format including Unit Price and Stock Value.
Category QR links can be copied, opened, reset, disabled, enabled, and downloaded as printable cabinet labels.
Resetting one category link revokes only that category QR and does not affect other cabinets.
Inventory menu access now defaults to full Inventory operations regardless of built-in/custom base role, preserving Storekeeper-style workflows.
Master Admin and Admin can set per-user Inventory permissions: View, Add, Edit/Adjust, Delete, and Public QR.
Inventory backend endpoints enforce the granular permissions, not only frontend button visibility.
Inventory report export requires Inventory View permission.
Users without explicit granular settings remain backward compatible: an existing Inventory menu assignment grants all Inventory operations by default.
Tracked updater now normalizes harmless Base64 whitespace before strict digital-signature verification to prevent CRM line-wrap failures.

versions.title: Public Inventory UX & PDF Metadata Fixes
versions.summary: Fixed Inventory public-link persistence and route collisions, simplified public/QR copy, and added proper metadata to AMT-generated PDFs.
changes: Fixed the Inventory page Item not found toast that appeared automatically for Admin/Master Admin.
Moved Inventory public-link management to a dedicated non-colliding API namespace.
Existing generated Inventory public links remain recognized correctly after page refresh.
Existing QR links now use View QR / Public Link instead of misleading users with Generate QR / Public Link.
Generate QR / Public Link appears only when no public link exists yet.
Simplified the public Inventory page subtitle and removed unnecessary technical explanation text.
Simplified the printable Inventory QR label text.
Added explicit PDF title, author, and subject metadata to generic AMT PDF exports.
Added explicit PDF metadata to Maintenance Report PDFs.
Browser PDF tabs and document properties now use proper AMT report titles instead of anonymous metadata.

versions.title: Secure Public Inventory QR
versions.summary: Added Admin-managed QR/Public Link access for a read-only physical-cabinet Inventory view with filtering and public Excel/PDF exports.
changes: Master Admin and Admin can generate, copy, open, disable, enable, reset, and download a printable QR label for the Inventory public view.
The Inventory QR/Public Link management section is hidden from Supervisor, Technician, Viewer, and public users.
Public Inventory links use a high-entropy token identifier plus HMAC signature and do not expose a reusable secret from the database.
Resetting the public link immediately revokes previously printed or shared QR links.
Disabling the public link immediately blocks public Inventory viewing and public exports without deleting Inventory data.
The public Inventory page is strictly read-only and has no add, edit, stock-adjustment, delete, user-management, or authenticated application controls.
Public users can search and filter by Category, Type, Stock Status, and Storage Location and can sort the visible Inventory list.
Public users can export the same filtered operational Inventory view to branded Excel or PDF reports.
Public output intentionally excludes internal database IDs, user data, inventory transaction history, and unit pricing.
Public Inventory endpoints include no-store, no-index, no-referrer headers and lightweight request throttling.
Public query values are length-limited and regex escaped before MongoDB filtering.
Public exports are generated server-side from an allowlisted field set and do not reuse authenticated Inventory mutation endpoints.
Administrative public-link lifecycle actions are written to the AMT Audit Trail.

versions.title: Inventory Export Center & Guided Excel Imports
versions.summary: Added a filterable Inventory Export Center for Excel/PDF reports and template-driven Equipment, Calibration, and Inventory imports with guided missing-equipment creation for Calibration assignments.
changes: Inventory now has one dedicated Export Center instead of duplicate export controls under the page title.
All authenticated users with Inventory access and export capability can export Inventory data to Excel or PDF.
Inventory exports can be filtered by Category, Type, Stock Status, and Storage Location.
Inventory export presets support all stock, low stock, out of stock, and healthy stock reporting.
Inventory exports include Category, Stock Status, Reorder Gap, Unit Price, and calculated Stock Value.
The existing Inventory list filters can be copied directly into the Export Center.
Excel Import now provides downloadable AMT templates for Equipment, Calibration, and Inventory.
Templates contain example data, instructions, required-field guidance, and dropdown validation for supported categorical fields.
Import validation reports total, new, duplicate, and invalid rows before execution.
Calibration import detects Assigned SAP numbers that do not exist in Equipment.
For each missing Calibration SAP, AMT asks whether the Equipment should be created automatically.
Automatically created Equipment is registered at Base and linked to the imported Calibration Tool.
Calibration rows with missing SAP can also be skipped intentionally.
Inventory import creates initial-stock transaction history when imported stock is greater than zero.
Legacy backend Equipment/Maintenance import compatibility remains available for existing integrations.

versions.title: Document Cleanup & Master Force Delete
versions.summary: Added Admin/Master document deletion from Equipment Documents, prevented stale calibration documents after tool archival, and added Master Admin-only force deletion for maintenance records.
changes: Admin and Master Admin can delete documents/files from Equipment > Documents.
Backend file deletion is restricted to Admin and Master Admin.
Deleting a calibration certificate file also cleans its linked calibration certificate metadata.
Archiving a calibration tool detaches its certificate history from the Equipment Documents index.
Maintenance document delete buttons are restricted to Admin and Master Admin while upload permissions remain unchanged.
Master Admin receives a dedicated Force Delete action for maintenance records.
Normal maintenance delete behavior remains unchanged for other authorized users.
Force Delete can remove Closed or ledger-backed maintenance records while preserving a concurrency safety lock.
Force Delete restores any still-deducted Ex-Stock quantity before removing the maintenance.
Force Delete removes linked failures, attachments, file records, and maintenance inventory ledger rows and records an audit event.

versions.title: Admin Custom Roles & Per-User Menu Access
versions.summary: Extended custom-role management to Admin accounts and made Menu Access individually configurable when creating or managing users assigned to custom roles.
changes: Master Admin and Admin can access and manage Custom Roles.
Custom-role base permission levels are validated against the authority of the account creating or editing the role.
Custom-role menu defaults cannot grant menus beyond those available to the creator.
Admins can create organization roles such as Storekeeper with Technician as the base permission.
When creating a user with a custom role, Menu Access remains editable with checkboxes.
The custom role provides the base permission and default menu selection, while each user keeps an individual Menu Access configuration.
Menu Access can also be changed later for users assigned to custom roles.
Editing a custom role keeps assigned users' individual Menu Access selections while synchronizing the role name and base permission.
Protected Master Admin authority remains built in and cannot be created as a custom role.

versions.title: Version Log & Custom User Roles
versions.summary: Added a dedicated Version History page and reusable custom user-role profiles managed by Master Admin while preserving AMT's built-in authorization hierarchy.
changes: Version & Updates remains accessible to Master Admin and Admin.
Version History now opens on a dedicated /version-history page instead of expanding inside Settings.
/version-log redirects to /version-history for a concise release-log URL.
Version History remains restricted to Master Admin and Admin.
Added Master Admin-only Custom Roles management at /roles.
Master Admin can create reusable role profiles such as Service Planner and Storekeeper.
Each custom role uses a safe built-in base permission level: Admin, Supervisor, Technician, or Viewer.
Custom role profiles define reusable menu access for assigned users.
Users can be created with a custom role profile or reassigned to one later.
Editing a custom role synchronizes its base permission and menu access to assigned users.
Deleting a custom role is blocked while users are still assigned to it.
Custom Master Admin role profiles are intentionally prohibited so protected Master Admin authority remains built-in.
Existing Admin and Supervisor user-management hierarchy and delegated menu-access limits remain enforced.

versions.title: Reporting, Version History & Public Guide
versions.summary: Replacement stable release for the revoked 1.1.6 package, including selective maintenance exports, public product documentation, branding consistency, and safer CRM signature handoff.
changes: Replaces revoked release 1.1.6 with a new immutable signed package.
Added Version History & Public Product Guide in Settings for Master Admin and Admin.
Version History is placed at the bottom of Settings and remains collapsed until View Version History is selected.
Added one always-current AMT Public Product Overview PDF generated on demand without accumulating persistent PDF files.
Public Equipment Passport follows configured company branding and falls back to the official bundled AMT logo after reset.
Maintenance Reports support checkbox selection so users can export only selected maintenance records.
Selected maintenance records can be exported into one consolidated PDF or one Excel workbook.
Existing full filtered maintenance PDF and Excel exports remain available.
Excel exports include title, generated timestamp, company or official AMT logo, styled headers, wrapped cells, filters, freeze panes, print layout, and AMT product credit.
PDF and Excel export branding uses the configured company logo when available and otherwise the official bundled AMT logo.
Synthetic text-only AMT logo fallback remains removed from report exports.
Release builder validates the target version against tracked version history before packaging.
Release builder now writes a dedicated signature-base64.txt file containing only the validated Base64 signature for safer copy/paste into LS CRM.

Master Admin and Admin can access eligible Application Branding.
Backend license checks remain active for protected licensed features.
Supervisor, Technician, and Viewer remain restricted from update and branding administration.
